scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong match is available
scope.selection_rule: Current actionable roles only; stale or expired postings excluded from this snapshot.

jobs.title: Associate Staff Scientist (Intestinal Organoids)
jobs.company_info: Cincinnati Children's combines intestinal organoids, stem-cell biology, tissue engineering and advanced in vitro model development.

salary.note: No reliable employer salary surfaced; third-party estimates vary.

jobs.job_description: Develop and characterize intestinal organoid and advanced in vitro systems using stem-cell biology, tissue engineering, imaging, transcriptomics and single-cell analysis.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD in relevant biological or engineering discipline
jobs.why_good_match: The strongest Ohio match: patient-derived intestinal organoids, Crohn's disease modeling, tissue engineering, confocal imaging and scRNA-seq all map directly.
likely_gaps: iPSC-derived intestinal organoid experience may be less extensive than adult patient-derived organoids
jobs.tailor: Lead with patient-derived intestinal organoids and CD chips, then scRNA-seq, confocal/IF and engineering. Explicitly distinguish adult-stem-cell organoid depth from willingness to expand into iPSC systems.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply now and ask during interview about first-author project ownership, grant participation and promotion path.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow – NHP Immunology and Organ Chips
jobs.company_info: The Wyss team is using Organ Chips to compare human and NHP adaptive immunity and radiation toxicity with spatial omics and functional data.
jobs.term: One-year term with possibility of extension

salary.note: Harvard postdoctoral scale based on years post-PhD.

jobs.posting_status: Official Wyss/Harvard pages remain live; encouraged application date was September 9, so apply immediately if still accepting
jobs.job_description: Use Organ Chips, spatial omics and functional assays to study adaptive immunity, vaccination and radiation toxicity across human and NHP systems, with pharma/regulatory exposure.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong collaborative analysis and publication skills
jobs.why_good_match: Radiation toxicity plus Organ Chips is unusually specific to the user's radiation-on-chip background, and the regulatory/pharma interaction adds translational breadth.
jobs.tailor: Open with radiation-on-chip, DNA damage/ROS/barrier assays and Organ Chip engineering; present scRNA/omics as evidence of computational adaptability rather than claiming NHP expertise.
jobs.immediate_action: Submit immediately while the official posting remains live; email the team with a concise radiation-chip fit statement.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher or Staff Scientist — Integrated Microphysiological Systems
jobs.company_info: The Ouyang group develops integrated microphysiological systems and bio-integrated microsystems at the engineering/medicine interface.

salary.note: Not listed on lab opportunity page.

jobs.posting_status: Lab page currently states it is seeking postdoctoral researcher or staff scientist candidates for integrated MPS
jobs.job_description: Develop integrated microphysiological systems within a bio-integrated microsystems lab spanning microdevices, sensing and biomedical engineering.
jobs.why_good_match: This would deepen the engineering side of the user's profile—microfabrication, device integration and MPS—rather than simply repeating GI biology.
likely_gaps: Exact project scope and funding terms require direct discussion
jobs.tailor: Lead with porous PDMS membrane fabrication, multiplex fluidics, pump/actuator design and organ-chip validation; include a visual engineering portfolio.
jobs.immediate_action: Contact Prof. Ouyang directly with a one-page research-fit note and ask whether the staff-scientist or postdoc track best matches an incoming PhD.

jobs.title: Research Fellow - Physiology & BME - Chang Lab
jobs.company_info: The Chang lab develops microfluidic technologies for molecular diagnostics and biomedical applications.

salary.note: Competitive salary; exact amount not listed in surfaced posting.

jobs.job_description: Develop miniaturized and automated microfluidic technologies for molecular diagnostics, with particular interest in droplet microfluidics and integrated molecular-biology workflows.
key_must_have_requirements: Interest in automated miniaturized assay systems
jobs.why_good_match: Strong microfluidics/fabrication fit and a chance to gain droplet and molecular-diagnostic engineering that is distinct from the user's current gut-chip platform.
likely_gaps: Less tissue-engineering and GI disease emphasis
jobs.tailor: Feature microfluidic design, flow control, PDMS fabrication, assay integration and quantitative troubleshooting; frame organ-chip experience as proof of reliable biological microdevice operation.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply before September 21; explicitly state interest in acquiring droplet microfluidics rather than pretending prior depth.

jobs.title: Staff Scientist I - Stem Cell Core
jobs.company_info: LIBD's stem-cell core supports human stem-cell models for developmental and neuropsychiatric disease research.
jobs.posting_status: Active; posted September 12 and closes October 12, 2026
jobs.job_description: Staff-scientist role in a stem-cell core supporting human stem-cell model generation, characterization and research workflows.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong reproducibility and service-oriented scientific execution
Ability to support multiple research programs
jobs.why_good_match: Organoid and advanced-cell-model experience transfers well, and the role could add iPSC/core-platform leadership experience.
likely_gaps: Neurodevelopmental disease is outside the user's GI/MPS niche
Core-service duties may reduce independent project ownership
jobs.tailor: Emphasize patient-derived model reproducibility, protocol optimization, training/mentoring, imaging and single-cell characterization.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply only if the role includes method development, authorship and platform ownership; otherwise prioritize Cincinnati/Dartmouth/Mayo.
